fields.label: What This Automation Does
fields.description: What this automation does while it is enabled, what stands in its place while it is not, and one example of the moment a user meets it.
The automation's name and its identity, read as Area::Subject::Behaviour. It is owned by the code catalog and cannot be renamed or created by hand.
fields.label: Automation Key

fields.description: The part of the CRM this automation acts on, taken from the first segment of the key. It is derived, not chosen, and is what the list groups by.
fields.label: Area

fields.description: What makes this automation run: a Doc Event (a record is saved, created or deleted), a Schedule (a background job on a clock), a Provider call (a request to or from an outside service), or a Permission check (a list or a record is read).
fields.label: Fires On
fields.options:
Doc Event
Schedule
Provider call
Permission

fields.description: The exact record and moment that make it fire, read as DocType · event. CRM Task · validate, for instance, means it rides every save of a task.
fields.label: Trigger Detail

fields.description: The one field an operator owns. Ticked, the tatva_connect hook rides and enforces what the description below sets out; unticked, the automation is dormant and native frappe/crm behaviour stands in its place. It can be toggled here or inline in the list, and the choice survives every deploy.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The automation this one leans on. It cannot be enabled while that one is off, and switching that one off switches this one off with it, so the dependency is enabled first and disabled last.
fields.label: Requires

fields.description: The background job a scheduled automation runs on. It is blank for every automation that fires on a doc event, a provider call or a permission check.
fields.label: Scheduled Job

fields.description: What this automation does while it is enabled, what stands in its place while it is not, and one example of the moment a user meets it. Code-owned reference text, re-seeded on every deploy.
fields.label: Description
